newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold closes unchanged in H.K. from New York levels.
newsitem.headline: Gold closes unchanged in H.K. from New York levels.

text.p: Gold closed unchanged on Wednesday from New York's overnight finish at US$382.70/383.20 an ounce after staying within a 30 cent range in extremely quiet trade, dealers said.
"We had nothing to do today. The market was mixed on the immediate gold trend with support seen at US$380 and resistance at US$385," said a dealer at a major bank.
"I saw no trading interest as most players wanted to square positions ahead of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) meeting to discuss its gold sales plan."
IMF board members resume talks later today on a proposal to sell off five million ounces of gold to help the world's poorest nations. A meeting last Friday produced no conclusion.
Local gold ended HK$3 lower at HK$3,528 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose from -6 to -4 on Wednesday.
